\section[(dialogue)]{Food, the home and school — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R103-first-pass-food-the-home-and-school}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for old and bad.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a chilli, butter, honey, oil, grapes
  \item an orange, a lemon, breakfast, an egg, yoghurt
  \item an onion, a mango, a window, a chair, a table
  \item a wall, a roof, a bed, a cupboard, the ground
  \item stairs, a mirror, a lamp, a fan, a key
  \item a cup, a plate, a spoon, a knife, a bottle
  \item a door, a kitchen, a book, an exercise book, a pen
  \item a school, a map, a lesson, a question, an answer
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A chilli? (\textbf{\mr{मिरची}}, \emph{mirchī}.) Butter? (\textbf{\mr{लोणी}}, \emph{loṇī}.) Honey? (\textbf{\mr{मध}}, \emph{madh}.) Oil? (\textbf{\mr{तेल}}, \emph{tel}.) Grapes? (\textbf{\mr{द्राक्षे}}, \emph{drākṣe}.) An orange? (\textbf{\mr{संत्रे}}, \emph{santre}.) A lemon? (\textbf{\mr{लिंबू}}, \emph{limbū}.) Breakfast? (\textbf{\mr{नाश्ता}}, \emph{nāshtā}.) An egg? (\textbf{\mr{अंडे}}, \emph{aṇḍe}.) Yoghurt? (\textbf{\mr{दही}}, \emph{dahī}.) An onion? (\textbf{\mr{कांदा}}, \emph{kāndā}.) A mango? (\textbf{\mr{आंबा}}, \emph{āmbā}.) A window? (\textbf{\mr{खिडकी}}, \emph{khiḍkī}.) A chair? (\textbf{\mr{खुर्ची}}, \emph{khurchī}.) A table? (\textbf{\mr{टेबल}}, \emph{ṭebal}.) A wall? (\textbf{\mr{भिंत}}, \emph{bhint}.) A roof? (\textbf{\mr{छप्पर}}, \emph{chhappar}.) A bed? (\textbf{\mr{पलंग}}, \emph{palaṅg}.) A cupboard? (\textbf{\mr{कपाट}}, \emph{kapāṭ}.) The ground? (\textbf{\mr{जमीन}}, \emph{jamīn}.) Stairs? (\textbf{\mr{जिना}}, \emph{jinā}.) A mirror? (\textbf{\mr{आरसा}}, \emph{ārsā}.) A lamp? (\textbf{\mr{दिवा}}, \emph{divā}.) A fan? (\textbf{\mr{पंखा}}, \emph{paṅkhā}.) A key? (\textbf{\mr{किल्ली}}, \emph{killī}.) A cup? (\textbf{\mr{कप}}, \emph{kap}.) A plate? (\textbf{\mr{ताट}}, \emph{tāṭ}.) A spoon? (\textbf{\mr{चमचा}}, \emph{chamchā}.) A knife? (\textbf{\mr{सुरी}}, \emph{surī}.) A bottle? (\textbf{\mr{बाटली}}, \emph{bāṭlī}.) A door? (\textbf{\mr{दार}}, \emph{dār}.) A kitchen? (\textbf{\mr{स्वयंपाकघर}}, \emph{svayampākghar}.) A book? (\textbf{\mr{पुस्तक}}, \emph{pustak}.) An exercise book? (\textbf{\mr{वही}}, \emph{vahī}.) A pen? (\textbf{\mr{पेन}}, \emph{pen}.) A school? (\textbf{\mr{शाळा}}, \emph{shāḷā}.) A map? (\textbf{\mr{नकाशा}}, \emph{nakāshā}.) A lesson? (\textbf{\mr{धडा}}, \emph{dhaḍā}.) A question? (\textbf{\mr{प्रश्न}}, \emph{prashna}.) An answer? (\textbf{\mr{उत्तर}}, \emph{uttar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Nature and animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R103-second-pass-nature-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a word and a game.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a word, a game, a letter, a picture, a tree
  \item a flower, a leaf, a mountain, a forest, a river
  \item a lake, a stone, sand, a field, a star
  \item the sun, the moon, the sea, fire, snow; ice
  \item rain, wind, the sky, a dog, a cat
  \item a horse, a cow, a goat, a sheep, a bird
  \item a mouse, a lion, a tiger, an elephant, a monkey
  \item a snake, a peacock, a bear, a camel, a butterfly
  \item an ant, a duck, new, old, bad
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A word? (\textbf{\mr{शब्द}}, \emph{shabda}.) A game? (\textbf{\mr{खेळ}}, \emph{kheḷ}.) A letter? (\textbf{\mr{पत्र}}, \emph{patra}.) A picture? (\textbf{\mr{चित्र}}, \emph{chitra}.) A tree? (\textbf{\mr{झाड}}, \emph{jhāḍ}.) A flower? (\textbf{\mr{फूल}}, \emph{phūl}.) A leaf? (\textbf{\mr{पान}}, \emph{pān}.) A mountain? (\textbf{\mr{डोंगर}}, \emph{ḍoṅgar}.) A forest? (\textbf{\mr{जंगल}}, \emph{jaṅgal}.) A river? (\textbf{\mr{नदी}}, \emph{nadī}.) A lake? (\textbf{\mr{तलाव}}, \emph{talāv}.) A stone? (\textbf{\mr{दगड}}, \emph{dagaḍ}.) Sand? (\textbf{\mr{वाळू}}, \emph{vāḷū}.) A field? (\textbf{\mr{शेत}}, \emph{shet}.) A star? (\textbf{\mr{तारा}}, \emph{tārā}.) The sun? (\textbf{\mr{सूर्य}}, \emph{sūrya}.) The moon? (\textbf{\mr{चंद्र}}, \emph{chandra}.) The sea? (\textbf{\mr{समुद्र}}, \emph{samudra}.) Fire? (\textbf{\mr{आग}}, \emph{āg}.) Snow; ice? (\textbf{\mr{बर्फ}}, \emph{barpha}.) Rain? (\textbf{\mr{पाऊस}}, \emph{pāūs}.) Wind? (\textbf{\mr{वारा}}, \emph{vārā}.) The sky? (\textbf{\mr{आकाश}}, \emph{ākāsh}.) A dog? (\textbf{\mr{कुत्रा}}, \emph{kutrā}.) A cat? (\textbf{\mr{मांजर}}, \emph{māñjar}.) A horse? (\textbf{\mr{घोडा}}, \emph{ghoḍā}.) A cow? (\textbf{\mr{गाय}}, \emph{gāy}.) A goat? (\textbf{\mr{शेळी}}, \emph{sheḷī}.) A sheep? (\textbf{\mr{मेंढी}}, \emph{meṇḍhī}.) A bird? (\textbf{\mr{पक्षी}}, \emph{pakṣī}.) A mouse? (\textbf{\mr{उंदीर}}, \emph{undīr}.) A lion? (\textbf{\mr{सिंह}}, \emph{siṁha}.) A tiger? (\textbf{\mr{वाघ}}, \emph{vāgh}.) An elephant? (\textbf{\mr{हत्ती}}, \emph{hattī}.) A monkey? (\textbf{\mr{माकड}}, \emph{mākaḍ}.) A snake? (\textbf{\mr{साप}}, \emph{sāp}.) A peacock? (\textbf{\mr{मोर}}, \emph{mor}.) A bear? (\textbf{\mr{अस्वल}}, \emph{asval}.) A camel? (\textbf{\mr{उंट}}, \emph{uṇṭ}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\mr{फुलपाखरू}}, \emph{phulpākhrū}.) An ant? (\textbf{\mr{मुंगी}}, \emph{muṅgī}.) A duck? (\textbf{\mr{बदक}}, \emph{badak}.) New? (\textbf{\mr{नवा}}, \emph{navā}.) Old? (\textbf{\mr{जुना}}, \emph{junā}.) Bad? (\textbf{\mr{वाईट}}, \emph{vāīṭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
